description: This file contains implementation code for big number arithmetic operations such as multiplication, addition, and squaring on large integers, typically used in cryptographic algorithms. The functions include bn_mul_add_words, bn_mul_words, bn_sqr_words, and supporting division and addition operations, with conditional compilation for different hardware capabilities.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_mul_add_words(BN_ULONG * rp,BN_ULONG * ap,int num,BN_ULONG w)
methods.description: Performs multiplication of multis with an addition, handling multiple words for big number calculations.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_mul_words(BN_ULONG * rp,BN_ULONG * ap,int num,BN_ULONG w)
methods.description: Multiplies an array of words by a single word, storing the result in an output array.

methods.name: void bn_sqr_words(BN_ULONG * r,BN_ULONG * a,int n)
methods.description: Squares an array of big number words.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_div_words(BN_ULONG h,BN_ULONG l,BN_ULONG d)
methods.description: Divides a 64-bit combined number (high and low parts) by a single word, returning the quotient.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_add_words(BN_ULONG * r,BN_ULONG * a,BN_ULONG * b,int n)
methods.description: Adds two big number arrays word-by-word, with conditional implementation based on hardware support.
